customers.evidence: To help all families discover the joy of everyday life.

employees.evidence: It gets our teams excited to come to work each day.

dei.evidence: Nearly half of our stores are managed by a female leader and more than a third by a leader of color.

community.evidence: We’re dedicated to being a good neighbor and working with our communities and partners to make life a little better everywhere we do business.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, upbeat tone centred on joy, fun and surprise, with first-person plural voice throughout. Customers are addressed first through the purpose statement. Community commitment is framed as 'dedicated' rather than measured. Much of the page is brand history and trivia, with few stated commitments on employees, environment or governance.
